# Schema Migration for Compile Runs

This feature facilitates the migration of the 'compile_runs' table's schema in the database. It adds new columns to track compilation details, including the number of files seen, parsed, failed, and a record of failed file names, aimed at enhancing the tracking and reporting of compilation coverage.
